meta.instrument: NASA MSL Curiosity Mastcam, solar imaging (880 nm and 440 nm)
sources: Lemmon, M. (2023). MSL aerosol optical depths, Mendeley Data, doi 10.17632/tbh3pg39xc.1
Montabone et al. (2020). Martian Year 34 column dust climatology from MCS, JGR Planets (v2-5)

fields.tau: MSL Mastcam 880 nm optical depth (median of that sol)
fields.tau440: MSL Mastcam 440 nm optical depth (median of that sol)
fields.globalDust: MY34 dust scenario, global area-weighted mean IR CDOD normalised to 610 Pa
fields.galeDust: same scenario at the grid cell containing Gale Crater
fields.galeObs: gridded observations (IWB) at Gale, same units; absent if no value
fields.ls: solar longitude from the MSL file

meta.note: Orbiter CDOD is infrared absorption optical depth; Mastcam tau is visible/near-IR. They are different quantities and are not numerically equal.
meta.statistic: median of observations on each sol; sols without observations are absent

map.note: values/100 = CDOD610; row-major lat (north to south) x lon (west to east)
